g.text: Food Rescue Platform (Replate) - End-to-End Donation & Delivery Lifecycle
POST /donations (Food details, Qty, Expiry, Pickup Lat/Lng)
Query eligible NGOs (Within radius, operating hours, capacity >= qty, food category allowed)
Fetch active weights from matching_weights_history(city, category)
Compute composite match score for each NGO
Find available drivers (status = AVAILABLE, capacity >= qty)
Rank drivers by distance to donation pickup
INSERT into deliveries (Status: DRIVER_ASSIGNED, driver_id, donation_id, ngo_id)
Polyline coordinates, Distance km, Duration min
Broadcast driver en route to Donor & NGO
INSERT into handover_records (Donor confirmation, qty, timestamp)
Record audit log with SHA-256 hash
Broadcast "Delivery Completed" to Donor, NGO, Admin
